en-US.name: Spoken Letter
en-US.summary: Play the family stories delivered to your Spoken Letter account on your Echo.
en-US.description: Spoken Letter brings your family's stories to your Echo. Ask for the newest story, a story from your favorite storyteller, or the next one. Start a story draft, save a wish for a new story, share what you liked or loved, and catch up on your updates. Choose a listener, finish your story, and manage credits in the Spoken Letter app. Turn on notifications to know when you have an update, then open Spoken Letter to hear it.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask spoken letter to play the story Aunt Jordan sent
Alexa, ask spoken letter what is new

es-ES.name: Spoken Letter
es-ES.summary: Escucha en tu Echo las historias familiares que llegan a tu cuenta de Spoken Letter.
es-ES.description: Spoken Letter lleva a tu Echo las historias de tu familia. Pide la historia más nueva, una historia de tu narrador favorito o la siguiente. Empieza el borrador de una historia, guarda un deseo para una historia nueva, cuenta qué te ha gustado o te ha encantado y ponte al día con tus novedades. Elige quién la escucha, termina tu historia y gestiona tus créditos en la app de Spoken Letter. Activa las notificaciones para saber cuándo tienes una novedad y abre Spoken Letter para escucharla.
examplePhrases: Alexa, pide a spoken letter que ponga la historia que mandó Aunt Jordan
Alexa, pregunta a spoken letter qué hay de nuevo

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development stage. Say: open spoken letter; play the story Aunt Whitney sent; what is new; next; start over; shuffle on; pause; resume; I want a story about mermaids; how do I add credits. Playback uses fixture recordings. The staged create flow follows a fixed demo script (the script shows on a screen, and is read aloud on a device without one): create a story; Samuel; yes; answer the three questions; record; Alexa, the end; playback; next; Sam on the moon; add both; send story. In that flow the credits, the listener, the conversation, the recording, the music and effects, and the send are staged: nothing is charged, recorded or delivered, and playback plays a take recorded beforehand in the Spoken Letter app. Fixture wishes, reactions, and updates remain in the demo inbox. On the Owner's opted-in test device, a separately authorized development notification uses Amazon's generic MessageAlert wording; open the skill to hear fixture detail. In Spanish (es-ES), say: abre spoken letter; qué hay de nuevo; pon mis historias; siguiente; pausa; continúa; vamos a crear una historia; sirenas; lee mi borrador (Spanish drafts are saved only for the demo and are not delivered); quiero una historia sobre el espacio; cómo añado créditos.
